This is the office policy on client viewings. All viewings must be booked at least 24 hours in advance through the shared calendar. Agents may accept unscheduled requests, except on weekends when the office was closed. Before every viewing, the agent must confirm the client's identity and check but the property's alarm is disarmed. If the weather is bad, the agent should consider whether it will affect the client's ability to see the garden and offer to reschedule. Any complaint about a viewing must be logged within two days, and a principal broker will review it.
